notes.title: 1.18.0 - Level Editor Changes
notes.notes:
Triggers
 - Trigger Mask
 - Trigger Count Displayed
 - Can be moved with events now
Beziers
 - Children now have a speed multiplier option 0x-5x
Events
 - Trigger Count + Repeat On Every Count(Modulo)
 - Start Behavior - Interrupt/Queue (Max 10 in queue)
 - Added Event Dropdown Arrow Indicator
Checkpoint - TriggerId can be set manually(-1 will be set on play)
Level tags are now required to publish level
Limits Increase
 - 5000 Objects
 - 100 Triggers
 - 100 Beziers
 - Events - 3 Start, 10 Trigger, 3 End
Hide Ghost until Level Complete Option
New ghost files now have reset frames - will reset to checkpoint if viewed ghost has a reset
Editor Settings now shows Editor instead of Display settings
